title: Old Musina Road outside Louis Trichardt (Makhado) (map point approximate): man found dead with his hands tied, 14 Nov
summary: The body of an unidentified man, believed to be about 35, was found in the bushes along the Old Musina Road outside Makhado (Louis Trichardt) on Saturday 14 November, Limpopo police said. Police on patrol were told about...
story: The body of an unidentified man, believed to be about 35, was found in the bushes along the Old Musina Road outside Makhado (Louis Trichardt) on Saturday 14 November, Limpopo police said. Police on patrol were told about the body at about 18:00. His hands had been tied behind his back and he had bruises on his neck and shoulders; police said he appeared to be homeless. A murder case was opened at Makhado police station and the suspects were unknown. The map point is approximate: the Louis Trichardt town point, not the scene.
incident: Sat 14 Nov 2026, found about 18:00 (SAPS Limpopo; IOL)
